tasks.subject: Task 1 (LA): Attachment-size threshold config and partitioning
tasks.description:
Add LARGE_ATTACHMENT_THRESHOLD (3*1024*1024), threshold property + getter/setter (setter rejects <1 with InvalidArgumentException), attachmentExceedsThreshold() measuring strlen(getBody()), and partitionAttachmentsBySize() returning [small,large] with >= threshold as large. TDD via reflection. No send() change.

tasks.subject: Task 2 (LA): Draft-then-send flow with upload sessions
tasks.description:
Add sendViaDraft() (draft POST -> attach small inline -> createUploadSession + uploadLargeAttachment per large -> send()->post()) and protected uploadLargeAttachment() seam using getRequestAdapter()+Utils::streamFor()+LargeFileUploadTask. id-less draft throws Swift_TransportException. 5 new imports. Test via reflection + partial mock stubbing uploadLargeAttachment.

tasks.subject: Task 3 (LA): Route large-attachment sends through draft flow in send()
tasks.description:
Branch send(): collect attachments minus invite parts, partitionAttachmentsBySize, useDraftFlow = [] !== large; only setAttachments on non-draft path; transmission branches between sendViaDraft() and sendMail()->post(). Tests: 4MB routes to draft (partial-mock sendViaDraft); tiny still uses sendMail. Full Graph suite must stay green.
